text: A dampener for Greater KL | The Star × View Nation A dampener for Greater KL By MENG YEW CHOONG Tuesday, 18 Oct 2016 | 12:00 AM MYT share bookmark Related Stories Thailand 2h ago Thai government insures 30 million homes against disasters from Oct 1 Aseanplus News 1d ago OpenAI apologises for Australian government website hack, pledges to rebuild trust Technology 1d ago OpenAI apologises for Australian government website hack, pledges to rebuild trust PETALING JAYA: Greater Kuala Lumpur ranks poorly in terms of the sustainability of its water-related infrastructure, coming in at 37th place among 50 global cities assessed under the Sustainable Cities Water Index.
